{{Quote|I should have quit after the Coruscant Classic.|translated=1|Yuka Rill to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Coruscant Classic''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|race]] that was held on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], at some point prior to<ref name="KOTOR" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] swoop racer [[Yuka Rill]] participated in the event.<ref name="KOTOR" /> In 3956 BBY,<ref name="NEC" /> Rill spoke of his participation with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in [[Motta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] registration office on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; the Ithorian expressed his belief that he should have quit the sport after the Classic.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Classic swoop race was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''.<ref name="KOTOR" />
